how: Each preset run in postfx.Rack (fades on, 512-sample blocks) over 6 s of eleven inputs: four Magenta RT 2 drones (seeds 21 to 24), a Celtic harp, an analogue modular synth and a synthetic kick, snare and hat loop, each set to -20 dBFS RMS (auto level's target), and the four drones again at their own level (-27 to -37 dBFS). Freeze's presets leave Freeze off, so they were run with it switched on 1 s in. None broken on any input (calibrate.broken against the dry input: clipping, silence, louder than -12 dBFS RMS, noise). Figures, means over the inputs of the change from the dry sound: timbre_median, level-free timbre distance in dB (measure.timbre_distance; the measure's own jitter, the dry sound against itself one chunk later, is 0.08 to 0.19 dB); level_mean, dB; centroid_mean_pct; side_mid_mean, side/mid energy ratio, dB; lr_mean, left/right level, dB; swing_mean, spread of the left/right level over 100 ms frames, dB; gap_mean, quietest 10% of 10 ms frames against the loudest 10%, dB (a tail filling the gaps raises it); rms_max and peak_max, the loudest output on any input, dBFS RMS and peak. heard_on: the inputs on which one of these moved by at least timbre 0.5, level 1, side/mid 1, left/right 1, swing 1 or gaps 1.5 dB. De-click changes clean input by design; its presets were measured on a drone, the drum loop and the harp with 42 zig-zag bursts of 2 to 150 samples added (clicked: bursts redrawn, and how far the error against the clean sound fell, dB) and on the clean inputs (false_repairs). Script: _tmp/review/fx_presets.py.
